# Crescent Syndicate

> Wholesale supplier of scaffolding accessories and construction hardware based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Established 1994. Trusted by 500+ contractors across South India.

Crescent Syndicate is a manufacturer and wholesale distributor of scaffolding accessories, formwork hardware, and construction fittings. The company serves contractors, builders, and construction firms across Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, and Telangana with over 27 product categories.

## Business Information

- **Business Name:** Crescent Syndicate
- **Type:** Manufacturer & Wholesale Supplier

## Products

### Tie Rod & Anchor Nut Systems (Featured)
- **Tie Rod** — High-tensile threaded tie rod for formwork and shuttering. Steel Grade Fe415. Available in 15mm, 17mm and custom lengths (1m, 1.5m, custom). Used with wing nuts and anchor nuts.
- **Anchor Nut (2 Wing)** — Heavy-duty two-wing anchor nut for formwork tie rod systems. Cast and forged variants. Fits 15mm and 17mm tie rods.
- **Wing Nut** — Ergonomic wing nut for hand-tightening on scaffolding and tie rod connections.

### Cups & Plates
- **Top Cup (Cast & Forged)** — Cuplock scaffolding top cup connecting horizontal ledgers to verticals at any angle.
- **Bottom Cup** — Fixed bottom cup for cuplock scaffolding verticals.
- **Ledger Blade** — Forged ledger blade for cuplock systems. Quick tool-free assembly.
- **Waller Plate** — Square steel bearing plate for load distribution at prop base and head.

### Pipes & Structural
- **Vertical Pipe** — High-tensile steel vertical pipe for scaffolding systems. Multiple lengths available.
- **Ledger Pipe** — Horizontal steel pipe connecting verticals. Precision-cut standard lengths.

### Couplers & Clamps
- **Forge Fix Coupler** — Right-angle forged coupler for 90° tube connections. Meets BS EN 74.
- **Forge Swivel** — 360° rotating forged swivel coupler for angular adjustments.
- **Sleeve Coupler** — Internal sleeve coupler for joining scaffold tubes end-to-end.
- **Sheet Fix** — Clamp for securing sheet materials, safety screens and debris nets to scaffolding.
- **Sheet Swivel** — Rotating swivel clamp for sheet materials at adjustable angles.
- **GOGO Clamp** — Quick-connect clamp for lightweight scaffolding tube connections.
- **Water Stopper** — Sealing component to prevent water leakage in formwork joints.

### Jacks & Support
- **U Head Jack** — U-shaped head jack for supporting formwork beams and slab tables.
- **Base Jack** — Threaded base jack for adjustable load distribution from vertical props.
- **Prop Sleeve** — Extension sleeve for adjusting prop height in shoring systems.
- **Spigot Pin** — Pin for connecting and jointing telescopic prop sections.
- **LT Prop** — Telescopic slab prop for slab and beam formwork support.

### Nuts, Bolts & Pins
- **Stub Pin With Wedge** — Locking pin with wedge for secure cuplock scaffolding connections.
- **Flip Pin** — Spring-loaded pin for quick tool-free scaffolding assembly.
- **Shuttering Clamp** — Quick-release lever clamp for joining and tightening formwork panels.
- **Joint Pin** — Internal pin for smooth scaffold tube coupling.
- **Prop Nut** — Hexagonal nut for securing adjustable props. Zinc-plated.
- **Gugu Machine** — Industrial press machine for forming and fixing scaffolding components.
